title: Querying and Summarizing Census PUMS Data in R
text:
Introduction
We will manipulate and process data sets from Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) census API. We are focusing on datasets for years 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024.

# tidyverse attaches dplyr, tibble, purrr, ggplot2, and lubridate. httr makes the web requests and jsonlite parses JSON.
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
